reference_sql:
SELECT parent_category,
       AVG(CASE WHEN units = 1 THEN net_revenue_eur END) AS avg_single_line_eur,
       AVG(CASE WHEN units >= 2 THEN net_revenue_eur END) AS avg_multi_line_eur
FROM sales
GROUP BY parent_category
alternatives: SELECT parent_category, AVG(net_revenue_eur) FILTER (WHERE units = 1) AS avg_single_line_eur, AVG(net_revenue_eur) FILTER (WHERE units >= 2) AS avg_multi_line_eur FROM sales GROUP BY parent_category

SELECT parent_category, AVG(CASE WHEN units = 1 THEN net_revenue_eur ELSE NULL END) AS avg_single_line_eur, AVG(CASE WHEN units > 1 THEN net_revenue_eur ELSE NULL END) AS avg_multi_line_eur FROM sales GROUP BY 1

other_way.sql: SELECT parent_category, AVG(net_revenue_eur) FILTER (WHERE units = 1) AS avg_single_line_eur, AVG(net_revenue_eur) FILTER (WHERE units >= 2) AS avg_multi_line_eur FROM sales GROUP BY parent_category
